import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score

r = pd.read_csv("reviews_text.csv")

def new_model(class_weight=None):
    return make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2)),
                         LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, class_weight=class_weight))

X_train, X_test, t_train, t_test = train_test_split(
    r["text"], r["topic"], test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=r["topic"])


import numpy as np
classes=sorted(r.topic.unique())
m=new_model().fit(X_train,t_train);p=m.predict(X_test)
f1_by_topic=dict(zip(classes,np.round(f1_score(t_test,p,labels=classes,average=None,zero_division=0),3)))
macro_f1=round(f1_score(t_test,p,labels=classes,average="macro",zero_division=0),3)
rarest=t_test.value_counts().idxmin();worst=min(f1_by_topic,key=f1_by_topic.get)
count_ratio=round(float((p==rarest).sum()/(t_test==rarest).sum()),3)
b=new_model("balanced").fit(X_train,t_train)
f1_rare_balanced=round(float(f1_score(t_test,b.predict(X_test),labels=classes,average=None,zero_division=0)[classes.index(rarest)]),3)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

r = pd.read_csv("reviews_text.csv")
y = (r["rating"] <= 3).astype(int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(r["text"], y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)


import numpy as np
m=make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2)),LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_train,y_train)
tn,fp,fn,tp=confusion_matrix(y_test,m.predict(X_test),labels=[0,1]).ravel()
tpr=tp/(tp+fn);fpr=fp/(fp+tn)
n=n.copy();n["period"]=np.where(n.date>=pd.Timestamp("2026-10-05"),"после","до")
f=n[n.shop_id=="KZN-2"]
adj={k:round(float((p-fpr)/(tpr-fpr)),3) for k,p in f.groupby("period").neg.mean().items()}
g=n.merge(pd.read_csv("reviews_new_gold.csv"),on="review_id",validate="one_to_one",suffixes=("","_gold"))
rows=[]
for period,p in g[g.shop_id=="KZN-2"].groupby("period"):
    tn1,fp1,fn1,tp1=confusion_matrix(p.complaint,p.neg,labels=[0,1]).ravel()
    a=tp1/(tp1+fn1);b=fp1/(fp1+tn1);obs=p.neg.mean()
    rows.append(dict(period=period,n=len(p),complaints=int(p.complaint.sum()),tpr=a,fpr=b,observed=obs,manual=p.complaint.mean(),adjusted=(obs-b)/(a-b)))
audit=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("period")
